column4: dialect-gated: this job (go test ./engine/... with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set) runs Postgres and skips MySQL and MSSQL -- cleat#1986's TestWorkflowDefDefaultsToTheAuthExposureClass iterates registeredBackends, so its mysql and mssql subtests both skip here while postgres runs.
